# 1 Clement Chapter 57 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 57 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_057_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 57

**57:1** You therefore who laid the foundation of the revolt, submit yourselves to the presbyters and receive correction toward repentance, bending the knees of your heart.

**57:2** Learn to be in subjection, laying aside the proud and arrogant boastfulness of your tongue; for it is better for you to be found small within the flock of Christ and honorable, than to be pre-eminent in reputation but cast out from his hope.

**57:3** For thus the all-excellent Wisdom says: "Behold, I will bring forth to you the declaration of my spirit; I will teach you my word.

**57:4** Since I called and you did not obey, and I stretched out my words and you paid no heed, and you set at naught my counsels and did not listen to my reproofs,

**57:5** therefore I also will laugh at your destruction, and I will rejoice over you when ruin comes upon you, and when sudden confusion overtakes you, and when catastrophe comes upon you like a tempest, or when your distress and affliction arrive.

**57:6** For it shall be that when you call upon me I will not hearken to you; the evil ones shall seek me and shall not find me. For they hated wisdom and chose not the fear of the LORD,

**57:7** neither would they heed my counsels, but mocked my reproofs.

**57:8** Therefore they shall eat of the fruits of their own way, and shall be filled with their own ungodliness.

**57:9** For because they wronged infants, they shall be put to death; and judgment shall destroy the ungodly.

**57:10** But the one who hears me shall dwell in confidence, and shall rest in hope undisturbed by fear of all evil."

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
